verdict.rationale: The only first-party bulk capability in the evidence is importing many configuration variables at once from a .env file or stdin, followed by a hot-reload. Nothing shows bulk actions across agents or other resources. The migration flow that recreates each workload is carried out by an external AI agent following a runbook, so it is a workaround, not a product bulk operation. Missing for 10: bulk operations across agents and other resource types (bulk deploy, delete, update, restart), batch API/CLI endpoints, documentation of bulk-operation limits or behavior, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once

citations.quote: Bulk import from a .env file (or stdin), then hot-reload
